3720static bool isStandardFunc(const MemberDef *md)
3721{
3722 return md->name()=="operator=" || // assignment operator
3723 md->isConstructor() || // constructor
3724 md->isDestructor(); // destructor
3725}
3726
3727void ClassDefImpl::mergeMembersFromBaseClasses(bool mergeVirtualBaseClass)
3728{
3729 SrcLangExt lang = getLanguage();
3730 DString sep=getLanguageSpecificSeparator(lang,true);
3731 size_t sepLen = sep.length();
3732 bool inlineInheritedMembers = Config_getBool(INLINE_INHERITED_MEMB);
3733 bool extractPrivate = Config_getBool(EXTRACT_PRIVATE);
3734
3735 auto insertMember = [&](const ClassDef *cd,MemberDef *md,Protection prot)
3736 {
3737 if (inlineInheritedMembers && !isStandardFunc(md))
3738 {
3739 //printf(" %s::insertMember(%s)\n",qPrint(name()),qPrint(srcMd->name()));
3740 internalInsertMember(md,prot,false);
3741 if (!cd->isLinkable()) // if the base is not linkable then move the member to this class
3742 {
3743 MemberDefMutable *mdm = toMemberDefMutable(md);
3744 mdm->moveTo(this);
3745 mdm->setExplicitInherited(true);
3746 }
3747 }
3748 };
3749
3750 //printf(" mergeMembers for %s mergeVirtualBaseClass=%d\n",qPrint(name()),mergeVirtualBaseClass);
3751 // the merge the base members with this class' members
3752 for (const auto &bcd : baseClasses())
3753 {
3754 ClassDefMutable *bClass=toClassDefMutable(bcd.classDef);
3755 if (bClass)
3756 {
3757 const MemberNameInfoLinkedMap &srcMnd = bClass->memberNameInfoLinkedMap();
3758 MemberNameInfoLinkedMap &dstMnd = m_allMemberNameInfoLinkedMap;
3759
3760 for (auto &srcMni : srcMnd)
3761 {
3762 MemberNameInfo *dstMni=dstMnd.find(srcMni->memberName());
3763 if (dstMni)
3764 // a member with that name is already in the class.
3765 // the member may hide or reimplement the one in the sub class
3766 // or there may be another path to the base class that is already
3767 // visited via another branch in the class hierarchy.
3768 {
3769 //printf(" %s hides member name %s\n",qPrint(bClass->name()),qPrint(srcMni->memberName()));
3770 for (auto &srcMi : *srcMni)
3771 {
3772 MemberDef *srcMd = srcMi->memberDef();
3773 bool found=false;
3774 bool ambiguous=false;
3775 bool hidden=false;
3776 const ClassDef *srcCd = srcMd->getClassDef();
3777 for (auto &dstMi : *dstMni)
3778 {
3779 const MemberDef *dstMd = dstMi->memberDef();
3780 if (srcMd!=dstMd) // different members
3781 {
3782 const ClassDef *dstCd = dstMd->getClassDef();
3783 //printf(" Is %s a base class of %s?\n",qPrint(srcCd->name()),qPrint(dstCd->name()));
3784 if (srcCd==dstCd || dstCd->isBaseClass(srcCd,true))
3785 // member is in the same or a base class
3786 {
3787 const ArgumentList &srcAl = srcMd->argumentList();
3788 const ArgumentList &dstAl = dstMd->argumentList();
3789 found=matchArguments2(
3790 srcMd->getOuterScope(),srcMd->getFileDef(),srcMd->typeString(),&srcAl,
3791 dstMd->getOuterScope(),dstMd->getFileDef(),dstMd->typeString(),&dstAl,
3792 true,lang
3793 );
3794 //printf(" Yes, matching (%s<->%s): %d\n",
3795 // qPrint(argListToString(srcMd->argumentList())),
3796 // qPrint(argListToString(dstMd->argumentList())),
3797 // found);
3798 hidden = hidden || !found;
3799 }
3800 else // member is in a non base class => multiple inheritance
3801 // using the same base class.
3802 {
3803 //printf(" $$ Existing member %s %s add scope %s\n",
3804 // qPrint(dstMi->ambiguityResolutionScope()),
3805 // qPrint(dstMd->name()),
3806 // qPrint(dstMi->scopePath().left(dstMi->scopePath().find("::")+2)));
3807
3808 size_t scopeSepPos = dstMi->scopePath().find(sep);
3809 DString scope = dstMi->scopePath().left(scopeSepPos!=DString::npos ? scopeSepPos+sepLen : 0);
3810 if (scope!=dstMi->ambiguityResolutionScope().left(scope.length()))
3811 {
3812 dstMi->setAmbiguityResolutionScope(scope+dstMi->ambiguityResolutionScope());
3813 }
3814 ambiguous=true;
3815 }
3816 }
3817 else // same members
3818 {
3819 // do not add if base class is virtual or
3820 // if scope paths are equal or
3821 // if base class is an interface (and thus implicitly virtual).
3822 //printf(" same member found srcMi->virt=%d dstMi->virt=%d\n",srcMi->virt(),dstMi->virt());
3823 if ((srcMi->virt()!=Specifier::Normal && dstMi->virt()!=Specifier::Normal) ||
3824 bClass->name()+sep+srcMi->scopePath() == dstMi->scopePath() ||
3825 dstMd->getClassDef()->compoundType()==Interface
3826 )
3827 {
3828 found=true;
3829 }
3830 else // member can be reached via multiple paths in the
3831 // inheritance tree
3832 {
3833 //printf(" $$ Existing member %s %s add scope %s\n",
3834 // qPrint(dstMi->ambiguityResolutionScope()),
3835 // qPrint(dstMd->name()),
3836 // qPrint(dstMi->scopePath().left(dstMi->scopePath().find("::")+2)));
3837
3838 size_t scopeSepPos = dstMi->scopePath().find(sep);
3839 DString scope = dstMi->scopePath().left(scopeSepPos!=DString::npos ? scopeSepPos+sepLen : 0);
3840 if (scope!=dstMi->ambiguityResolutionScope().left(scope.length()))
3841 {
3842 dstMi->setAmbiguityResolutionScope(dstMi->ambiguityResolutionScope()+scope);
3843 }
3844 ambiguous=true;
3845 }
3846 }
3847 if (found) break;
3848 }
3849 //printf(" member %s::%s hidden %d ambiguous %d srcMi->ambigClass=%p found=%d\n",
3850 // qPrint(srcCd->name()),qPrint(srcMd->name()),hidden,ambiguous,
3851 // (void*)srcMi->ambigClass(),found);
3852
3853 // TODO: fix the case where a member is hidden by inheritance
3854 // of a member with the same name but with another prototype,
3855 // while there is more than one path to the member in the
3856 // base class due to multiple inheritance. In this case
3857 // it seems that the member is not reachable by prefixing a
3858 // scope name either (according to my compiler). Currently,
3859 // this case is shown anyway.
3860 if (!found && srcMd->protection()!=Protection::Private && !srcMd->isFriend() &&
3861 srcMi->virtualBaseClass()==mergeVirtualBaseClass && lang!=SrcLangExt::Python)
3862 {
3863 Protection prot = srcMd->protection();
3864 if (bcd.prot==Protection::Protected && prot==Protection::Public)
3865 {
3866 prot = bcd.prot;
3867 }
3868 else if (bcd.prot==Protection::Private)
3869 {
3870 prot = bcd.prot;
3871 }
3872
3873 insertMember(bClass,srcMd,prot);
3874
3875 Specifier virt=srcMi->virt();
3876 if (virt==Specifier::Normal && bcd.virt!=Specifier::Normal) virt=bcd.virt;
3877 bool virtualBaseClass = bcd.virt!=Specifier::Normal;
3878
3879 auto newMi = std::make_unique<MemberInfo>(srcMd,prot,virt,true,virtualBaseClass);
3880 newMi->setScopePath(bClass->name()+sep+srcMi->scopePath());
3881 if (ambiguous)
3882 {
3883 //printf("$$ New member %s %s add scope %s::\n",
3884 // qPrint(srcMi->ambiguityResolutionScope),
3885 // qPrint(srcMd->name()),
3886 // qPrint(bClass->name()));
3887
3888 DString scope=bClass->name()+sep;
3889 if (scope!=srcMi->ambiguityResolutionScope().left(scope.length()))
3890 {
3891 newMi->setAmbiguityResolutionScope(scope+srcMi->ambiguityResolutionScope());
3892 }
3893 }
3894 if (hidden)
3895 {
3896 if (srcMi->ambigClass()==nullptr)
3897 {
3898 newMi->setAmbigClass(bClass);
3899 newMi->setAmbiguityResolutionScope(bClass->name()+sep);
3900 }
3901 else
3902 {
3903 newMi->setAmbigClass(srcMi->ambigClass());
3904 newMi->setAmbiguityResolutionScope(srcMi->ambigClass()->name()+sep);
3905 }
3906 }
3907 dstMni->push_back(std::move(newMi));
3908 }
3909 }
3910 }
3911 else // base class has a member that is not in the sub class => copy
3912 {
3913 //printf(" %s adds member name %s\n",qPrint(bClass->name()),qPrint(srcMni->memberName()));
3914 // create a deep copy of the list (only the MemberInfo's will be
3915 // copied, not the actual MemberDef's)
3916 MemberNameInfo *newMni = dstMnd.add(srcMni->memberName());
3917
3918 // copy the member(s) from the base to the sub class
3919 for (auto &mi : *srcMni)
3920 {
3921 if (mi->virtualBaseClass()==mergeVirtualBaseClass && !mi->memberDef()->isFriend()) // don't inherit friends
3922 {
3923 Protection prot = mi->prot();
3924 if (bcd.prot==Protection::Protected)
3925 {
3926 if (prot==Protection::Public) prot=Protection::Protected;
3927 }
3928 else if (bcd.prot==Protection::Private)
3929 {
3930 prot=Protection::Private;
3931 }
3932 Specifier virt=mi->virt();
3933 bool virtualBaseClass = bcd.virt!=Specifier::Normal || mi->virtualBaseClass();
3934 if (virt==Specifier::Normal && bcd.virt!=Specifier::Normal) virt=bcd.virt;
3935 //printf(" %s::%s: [mi.prot=%d, bcd.prot=%d => prot=%d], [mi.virt=%d, bcd.virt=%d => virt=%d] virtualBase=%d\n",
3936 // qPrint(name()),qPrint(mi->memberDef()->name()),
3937 // mi->prot(),bcd.prot,prot,
3938 // mi->virt(),bcd.virt,virt,
3939 // virtualBaseClass
3940 // );
3941
3942 if (prot!=Protection::Private || extractPrivate)
3943 {
3944 insertMember(bClass,mi->memberDef(),prot);
3945
3946 //printf("Adding!\n");
3947 std::unique_ptr<MemberInfo> newMi = std::make_unique<MemberInfo>(mi->memberDef(),prot,virt,true,virtualBaseClass);
3948 newMi->setScopePath(bClass->name()+sep+mi->scopePath());
3949 newMi->setAmbigClass(mi->ambigClass());
3950 newMi->setAmbiguityResolutionScope(mi->ambiguityResolutionScope());
3951 newMni->push_back(std::move(newMi));
3952 }
3953 }
3954 }
3955 }
3956 }
3957 }
3958 }
3959}
3960
3961// See issue11260, referring to a variable in a base class will make doxygen
3962// add it as a member to the derived class, but this is not correct for non-private variables
3963// so we correct this here, now we know the inheritance hierarchy
3964void ClassDefImpl::hideDerivedVariablesInPython(ClassDefMutable *bClass)
3965{
3966 //printf("hideDerivedVariableInPython()\n");
3967 if (bClass)
3968 {
3969 const MemberNameInfoLinkedMap &srcMnd = bClass->memberNameInfoLinkedMap();
3970 MemberNameInfoLinkedMap &dstMnd = m_allMemberNameInfoLinkedMap;
3971
3972 // recurse up the inheritance hierarchy
3973 for (const auto &bcd : bClass->baseClasses())
3974 {
3975 hideDerivedVariablesInPython(toClassDefMutable(bcd.classDef));
3976 }
3977
3978 for (auto &srcMni : srcMnd) // for each member in a base class
3979 {
3980 //printf(" candidate(%s)\n",qPrint(srcMni->memberName()));
3981 MemberNameInfo *dstMni=dstMnd.find(srcMni->memberName());
3982 if (dstMni) // that is also in this class
3983 {
3984 MemberNameInfo::iterator it;
3985 //printf("%s member in %s and %s\n",qPrint(name()),qPrint(bClass->name()),qPrint(name()));
3986 for (it=dstMni->begin();it!=dstMni->end();)
3987 {
3988 MemberDefMutable *dstMd = toMemberDefMutable((*it)->memberDef());
3989 if (dstMd && dstMd->isVariable() && !dstMd->name().startsWith("__"))
3990 {
3991 //printf(" hiding member %s\n",qPrint(dstMd->name()));
3992 // hide a member variable if it is already defined in a base class, unless
3993 // it is a __private variable
3994 removeMemberFromLists(dstMd);
3995 it = dstMni->erase(it);
3996 }
3997 else
3998 {
3999 ++it;
4000 }
4001 }
4002 if (dstMni->empty()) // if the list has become empty, remove the entry from the dictionary
4003 {
4004 dstMnd.del(srcMni->memberName());
4005 }
4006 }
4007 }
4008 }
4009}
4010
4011/*!
4012 * recursively merges the 'all members' lists of a class base
4013 * with that of this class. Must only be called for classes without
4014 * subclasses!
4015 */
4016void ClassDefImpl::mergeMembers()
4017{
4018 if (m_membersMerged) return;
4019 if (getLanguage()==SrcLangExt::Python)
4020 {
4021 for (const auto &bcd : baseClasses())
4022 {
4023 ClassDefMutable *bClass=toClassDefMutable(bcd.classDef);
4024 hideDerivedVariablesInPython(bClass);
4025 }
4026 }
4027
4028 //printf("> %s::mergeMembers()\n",qPrint(name()));
4029
4030 m_membersMerged=true;
4031
4032 // first merge the members of the base class recursively
4033 for (const auto &bcd : baseClasses())
4034 {
4035 ClassDefMutable *bClass=toClassDefMutable(bcd.classDef);
4036 if (bClass)
4037 {
4038 // merge the members in the base class of this inheritance branch first
4039 bClass->mergeMembers();
4040 }
4041 }
4042
4043 // first merge the member that are not inherited via a virtual base class
4044 // (as this can end up reimplemented via multiple paths, see #10717 for examples)
4045 mergeMembersFromBaseClasses(false);
4046 // then process the member that are inherited via a virtual base class to add the
4047 // ones that are not reimplemented via any path
4048 mergeMembersFromBaseClasses(true);
4049
4050 //printf("< %s::mergeMembers()\n",qPrint(name()));
4051}

4054
4055/*! Merges the members of a Objective-C category into this class.
4056 */
4057void ClassDefImpl::mergeCategory(ClassDef *cat)
4058{
4059 AUTO_TRACE();
4060 ClassDefMutable *category = toClassDefMutable(cat);
4061 if (category)
4062 {
4063 bool extractLocalMethods = Config_getBool(EXTRACT_LOCAL_METHODS);
4064 bool makePrivate = category->isLocal();
4065 // in case extract local methods is not enabled we don't add the methods
4066 // of the category in case it is defined in the .m file.
4067 if (makePrivate && !extractLocalMethods) return;
4068 bool isExtension = category->isExtension();
4069
4070 category->setCategoryOf(this);
4071 if (isExtension)
4072 {
4073 category->setArtificial(true);
4074
4075 // copy base classes/protocols from extension
4076 for (const auto &bcd : category->baseClasses())
4077 {
4078 insertBaseClass(bcd.classDef,bcd.usedName,bcd.prot,bcd.virt,bcd.templSpecifiers);
4079 // correct bcd.classDef so that they do no longer derive from
4080 // category, but from this class!
4081 BaseClassList scl = bcd.classDef->subClasses();
4082 for (auto &scd : scl)
4083 {
4084 if (scd.classDef==category)
4085 {
4086 scd.classDef=this;
4087 }
4088 }
4089 bcd.classDef->updateSubClasses(scl);
4090 }
4091 }
4092 // make methods private for categories defined in the .m file
4093 //printf("%s::mergeCategory makePrivate=%d\n",qPrint(name()),makePrivate);
4094
4095 const MemberNameInfoLinkedMap &srcMnd = category->memberNameInfoLinkedMap();
4096 MemberNameInfoLinkedMap &dstMnd = m_allMemberNameInfoLinkedMap;
4097
4098 for (auto &srcMni : srcMnd)
4099 {
4100 MemberNameInfo *dstMni=dstMnd.find(srcMni->memberName());
4101 if (dstMni) // method is already defined in the class
4102 {
4103 AUTO_TRACE_ADD("Existing member {}",srcMni->memberName());
4104 const auto &dstMi = dstMni->front();
4105 const auto &srcMi = srcMni->front();
4106 if (srcMi && dstMi)
4107 {
4108 MemberDefMutable *smdm = toMemberDefMutable(srcMi->memberDef());
4109 MemberDefMutable *dmdm = toMemberDefMutable(dstMi->memberDef());
4110 if (smdm && dmdm)
4111 {
4112 combineDeclarationAndDefinition(smdm,dmdm);
4113 dmdm->setCategory(category);
4114 dmdm->setCategoryRelation(smdm);
4115 smdm->setCategoryRelation(dmdm);
4116 }
4117 }
4118 }
4119 else // new method name
4120 {
4121 AUTO_TRACE_ADD("New member {}",srcMni->memberName());
4122 // create a deep copy of the list
4123 MemberNameInfo *newMni = dstMnd.add(srcMni->memberName());
4124
4125 // copy the member(s) from the category to this class
4126 for (auto &mi : *srcMni)
4127 {
4128 //printf("Adding '%s'\n",qPrint(mi->memberDef->name()));
4129 Protection prot = mi->prot();
4130 //if (makePrivate) prot = Private;
4131 auto newMd = mi->memberDef()->deepCopy();
4132 if (newMd)
4133 {
4134 auto mmd = toMemberDefMutable(newMd.get());
4135 AUTO_TRACE_ADD("Copying member {}",mmd->name());
4136 if (mmd)
4137 {
4138 mmd->moveTo(this);
4139 }
4140
4141 auto newMi=std::make_unique<MemberInfo>(newMd.get(),prot,mi->virt(),mi->inherited(),mi->virtualBaseClass());
4142 newMi->setScopePath(mi->scopePath());
4143 newMi->setAmbigClass(mi->ambigClass());
4144 newMi->setAmbiguityResolutionScope(mi->ambiguityResolutionScope());
4145 newMni->push_back(std::move(newMi));
4146
4147 // also add the newly created member to the global members list
4148
4149 DString name = newMd->name();
4150 MemberName *mn = Doxygen::memberNameLinkedMap->add(name);
4151
4152 if (mmd)
4153 {
4154 mmd->setCategory(category);
4155 mmd->setCategoryRelation(mi->memberDef());
4156 }
4157 auto miMmd = toMemberDefMutable(mi->memberDef());
4158 if (miMmd) miMmd->setCategoryRelation(newMd.get());
4159
4160 if (mmd && (makePrivate || isExtension))
4161 {
4162 mmd->makeImplementationDetail();
4163 }
4164 internalInsertMember(newMd.get(),prot,false);
4165 mn->push_back(std::move(newMd));
4166 }
4167 }
4168 }
4169 }
4170 }
4171}

4174
4175void ClassDefImpl::addUsedClass(ClassDef *cd,const DString &accessName,
4176 Protection prot)
4177{
4178 bool extractPrivate = Config_getBool(EXTRACT_PRIVATE);
4179 bool umlLook = Config_getBool(UML_LOOK);
4180 if (prot==Protection::Private && !extractPrivate) return;
4181 //printf("%s::addUsedClass(%s,%s)\n",qPrint(name()),qPrint(cd->name()),accessName);
4182
4183 auto it = std::find_if(m_usesImplClassList.begin(),
4184 m_usesImplClassList.end(),
4185 [&cd](const auto &ucd) { return ucd.classDef==cd; });
4186 if (it==m_usesImplClassList.end())
4187 {
4188 m_usesImplClassList.emplace_back(cd);
4189 //printf("Adding used class %s to class %s via accessor %s\n",
4190 // qPrint(cd->name()),qPrint(name()),accessName);
4191 it = m_usesImplClassList.end()-1;
4192 }
4193 DString acc = accessName;
4194 if (umlLook)
4195 {
4196 switch(prot)
4197 {
4198 case Protection::Public: acc.prepend("+"); break;
4199 case Protection::Private: acc.prepend("-"); break;
4200 case Protection::Protected: acc.prepend("#"); break;
4201 case Protection::Package: acc.prepend("~"); break;
4202 }
4203 }
4204 (*it).addAccessor(acc);
4205}

4245DString ClassDefImpl::getOutputFileBase() const
4246{
4247 bool inlineGroupedClasses = Config_getBool(INLINE_GROUPED_CLASSES);
4248 bool inlineSimpleClasses = Config_getBool(INLINE_SIMPLE_STRUCTS);
4249 if (!Doxygen::generatingXmlOutput)
4250 {
4251 Definition *scope=nullptr;
4252 if (inlineGroupedClasses && !partOfGroups().empty())
4253 {
4254 // point to the group that embeds this class
4255 return partOfGroups().front()->getOutputFileBase();
4256 }
4257 else if (inlineSimpleClasses && m_isSimple && !partOfGroups().empty())
4258 {
4259 // point to simple struct inside a group
4260 return partOfGroups().front()->getOutputFileBase();
4261 }
4262 else if (inlineSimpleClasses && m_isSimple && (scope=getOuterScope()))
4263 {
4264 if (scope==Doxygen::globalScope && getFileDef() && getFileDef()->isLinkableInProject()) // simple struct embedded in file
4265 {
4266 return getFileDef()->getOutputFileBase();
4267 }
4268 else if (scope->isLinkableInProject()) // simple struct embedded in other container (namespace/group/class)
4269 {
4270 return getOuterScope()->getOutputFileBase();
4271 }
4272 }
4273 }
4274 AUTO_TRACE("name='{}' m_templateMaster={} m_implicitTemplateInstance={}",name(),(void*)m_templateMaster,m_implicitTemplateInstance);
4275 if (m_templateMaster && m_implicitTemplateInstance)
4276 {
4277 // point to the template of which this class is an instance
4278 return m_templateMaster->getOutputFileBase();
4279 }
4280 return m_fileName;
4281}

4334
4335ClassDef *ClassDefImpl::insertTemplateInstance(const DString &fileName,
4336 int startLine, size_t startColumn, const DString &templSpec,bool &freshInstance)
4337{
4338 freshInstance = false;
4339 auto it = std::find_if(m_templateInstances.begin(),
4340 m_templateInstances.end(),
4341 [&templSpec](const auto &ti) { return templSpec==ti.templSpec; });
4342 ClassDefMutable *templateClass=nullptr;
4343 if (it!=m_templateInstances.end())
4344 {
4345 templateClass = toClassDefMutable((*it).classDef);
4346 }
4347 if (templateClass==nullptr)
4348 {
4349 DString tcname = removeRedundantWhiteSpace(name()+templSpec);
4350 AUTO_TRACE("New template instance class name='{}' templSpec='{}' inside '{}' hidden={}",
4351 name(),templSpec,name(),isHidden());
4352
4353 ClassDef *foundCd = Doxygen::classLinkedMap->find(tcname);
4354 if (foundCd)
4355 {
4356 return foundCd;
4357 }
4358 templateClass =
4359 toClassDefMutable(
4360 Doxygen::classLinkedMap->add(tcname,
4361 std::unique_ptr<ClassDef>(
4362 new ClassDefImpl(fileName,startLine,startColumn,tcname,ClassDef::Class))));
4363 if (templateClass)
4364 {
4365 templateClass->setTemplateMaster(this);
4366 ArgumentList tal = *stringToArgumentList(getLanguage(),templSpec);
4367 templateClass->setTemplateArguments(tal);
4368 templateClass->setOuterScope(getOuterScope());
4369 templateClass->setHidden(isHidden());
4370 templateClass->setArtificial(isArtificial());
4371 templateClass->setImplicitTemplateInstance(true);
4372 m_templateInstances.emplace_back(templSpec,templateClass);
4373
4374 // also add nested classes
4375 for (const auto &innerCd : m_innerClasses)
4376 {
4377 DString innerName = tcname+"::"+innerCd->localName();
4378 ClassDefMutable *innerClass =
4379 toClassDefMutable(
4380 Doxygen::classLinkedMap->add(innerName,
4381 std::unique_ptr<ClassDef>(
4382 new ClassDefImpl(fileName,startLine,startColumn,innerName,ClassDef::Class))));
4383 if (innerClass)
4384 {
4385 templateClass->addInnerCompound(innerClass);
4386 innerClass->setOuterScope(templateClass);
4387 innerClass->setHidden(isHidden());
4388 innerClass->setArtificial(true);
4389 innerClass->setImplicitTemplateInstance(true);
4390 }
4391 }
4392 freshInstance=true;
4393 }
4394 }
4395 return templateClass;
4396}

4414void ClassDefImpl::addMemberToTemplateInstance(const MemberDef *md,
4415 const ArgumentList &templateArguments,
4416 const DString &templSpec)
4417{
4418 AUTO_TRACE("this={} md={}",name(),md->name());
4419 auto actualArguments_p = stringToArgumentList(getLanguage(),templSpec);
4420 auto imd = md->createTemplateInstanceMember(templateArguments,actualArguments_p);
4421 auto mmd = toMemberDefMutable(imd.get());
4422 mmd->setMemberClass(this);
4423 mmd->setTemplateMaster(md);
4424 mmd->setDocumentation(md->documentation(),md->docFile(),md->docLine());
4425 mmd->setBriefDescription(md->briefDescription(),md->briefFile(),md->briefLine());
4426 mmd->setInbodyDocumentation(md->inbodyDocumentation(),md->inbodyFile(),md->inbodyLine());
4427 mmd->setMemberSpecifiers(md->getMemberSpecifiers());
4428 mmd->setMemberGroupId(md->getMemberGroupId());
4429 mmd->setArtificial(true);
4430 insertMember(imd.get());
4431 //printf("Adding member=%s %s%s to class %s templSpec %s\n",
4432 // imd->typeString(),qPrint(imd->name()),imd->argsString(),
4433 // qPrint(imd->getClassDef()->name()),templSpec);
4434 // insert imd in the list of all members
4435 //printf("Adding member=%s class=%s\n",qPrint(imd->name()),qPrint(name()));
4436 MemberName *mn = Doxygen::memberNameLinkedMap->add(imd->name());
4437 mn->push_back(std::move(imd));
4438}

4440void ClassDefImpl::addMembersToTemplateInstance(const ClassDef *cd,const ArgumentList &templateArguments,const DString &templSpec)
4441{
4442 AUTO_TRACE("this={} cd={} templSpec={}",name(),cd->name(),templSpec);
4443 //printf("%s::addMembersToTemplateInstance(%s,%s)\n",qPrint(name()),qPrint(cd->name()),templSpec);
4444 for (const auto &mni : cd->memberNameInfoLinkedMap())
4445 {
4446 for (const auto &mi : *mni)
4447 {
4448 const MemberDef *md = mi->memberDef();
4449 if (m_allMemberNameInfoLinkedMap.find(md->name())==nullptr) // only insert the member if not hidden by one with the same name (#11541)
4450 {
4451 addMemberToTemplateInstance(md,templateArguments,templSpec);
4452 }
4453 }
4454 }
4455 // also instantiate members for nested classes
4456 for (const auto &innerCd : cd->getClasses())
4457 {
4458 ClassDefMutable *ncd = toClassDefMutable(m_innerClasses.find(innerCd->localName()));
4459 if (ncd)
4460 {
4461 ncd->addMembersToTemplateInstance(innerCd,cd->templateArguments(),templSpec);
4462 }
4463 }
4464}

4632void ClassDefImpl::sortMemberLists()
4633{
4634 for (auto &ml : m_memberLists)

4639 {
4640 std::stable_sort(m_innerClasses.begin(),
4641 m_innerClasses.end(),
4642 [](const auto &c1,const auto &c2)

4650
4651int ClassDefImpl::countMemberDeclarations(MemberListType lt,const ClassDef *inheritedFrom,
4652 MemberListType lt2,bool invert,bool showAlways,ClassDefSet &visitedClasses) const
4653{
4654 //printf("%s: countMemberDeclarations for %s and %s\n",qPrint(name()),lt.to_string(),lt2.to_string());
4655 int count=0;
4656 MemberList * ml = getMemberList(lt);
4657 MemberList * ml2 = getMemberList(lt2);
4658 if (getLanguage()!=SrcLangExt::VHDL) // use specific declarations function
4659 {
4660 if (ml)
4661 {
4662 count+=ml->numDecMembers(inheritedFrom);
4663 //printf("-> ml=%d\n",ml->numDecMembers());
4664 }
4665 if (ml2)
4666 {
4667 count+=ml2->numDecMembers(inheritedFrom);
4668 //printf("-> ml2=%d\n",ml2->numDecMembers());
4669 }
4670 // also include grouped members that have their own section in the class (see bug 722759)
4671 if (inheritedFrom)
4672 {
4673 for (const auto &mg : m_memberGroups)
4674 {
4675 count+=mg->countGroupedInheritedMembers(lt);
4676 if (!lt2.isInvalid()) count+=mg->countGroupedInheritedMembers(lt2);
4677 }
4678 }
4679 bool inlineInheritedMembers = Config_getBool(INLINE_INHERITED_MEMB);
4680 if (!inlineInheritedMembers) // show inherited members as separate lists
4681 {
4682 count+=countInheritedDecMembers(lt,inheritedFrom,invert,showAlways,visitedClasses);
4683 }
4684 }
4685 //printf("-> %d\n",count);
4686 return count;
4687}

4728
4729int ClassDefImpl::countInheritedDecMembers(MemberListType lt,
4730 const ClassDef *inheritedFrom,bool invert,bool showAlways,
4731 ClassDefSet &visitedClasses) const
4732{
4733 int inhCount = 0;
4734 int count = countMembersIncludingGrouped(lt,inheritedFrom,false);
4735 bool process = count>0;
4736 //printf("%s: countInheritedDecMembers: lt=%s process=%d count=%d invert=%d\n",
4737 // qPrint(name()),lt.to_string(),process,count,invert);
4738 if ((process^invert) || showAlways)
4739 {
4740 for (const auto &ibcd : m_inherits)
4741 {
4742 ClassDefMutable *icd = toClassDefMutable(ibcd.classDef);
4743 MemberListType lt1 = MemberListType::Invalid();
4744 MemberListType lt2 = MemberListType::Invalid();
4745 if (icd && icd->isLinkable())
4746 {
4747 convertProtectionLevel(lt,ibcd.prot,&lt1,&lt2);
4748 //printf("%s: convert %s->(%s,%s) prot=%d\n",
4749 // qPrint(icd->name()),lt.to_string(),lt1.to_string(),lt2.to_string(),ibcd.prot);
4750 if (visitedClasses.find(icd)==visitedClasses.end())
4751 {
4752 visitedClasses.insert(icd); // guard for multiple virtual inheritance
4753 if (!lt1.isInvalid())
4754 {
4755 inhCount+=icd->countMemberDeclarations(lt1,inheritedFrom,lt2,false,true,visitedClasses);
4756 }
4757 }
4758 }
4759 }
4760 }
4761 //printf("%s: count=%d\n",qPrint(name()),inhCount);
4762 return inhCount;
4763}

4786int ClassDefImpl::countAdditionalInheritedMembers() const
4787{
4788 int totalCount=0;
4789 for (const auto &lde : LayoutDocManager::instance().docEntries(LayoutDocManager::Class))
4790 {
4791 if (lde->kind()==LayoutDocEntry::MemberDecl)
4792 {
4793 const LayoutDocEntryMemberDecl *lmd = dynamic_cast<const LayoutDocEntryMemberDecl*>(lde.get());
4794 if (lmd && lmd->type!=MemberListType::Friends()) // friendship is not inherited
4795 {
4796 ClassDefSet visited;
4797 totalCount+=countInheritedDecMembers(lmd->type,this,true,false,visited);

4822int ClassDefImpl::countMembersIncludingGrouped(MemberListType lt,
4823 const ClassDef *inheritedFrom,bool additional) const
4824{
4825 int count=0;
4826 MemberList *ml = getMemberList(lt);
4827 if (ml)
4828 {
4829 count=ml->countInheritableMembers(inheritedFrom);
4830 }
4831 //printf("%s:countMembersIncludingGrouped: count=%d\n",qPrint(name()),count);
4832 for (const auto &mg : m_memberGroups)
4833 {
4834 bool hasOwnSection = !mg->allMembersInSameSection() ||
4835 !m_subGrouping; // group is in its own section
4836 if ((additional && hasOwnSection) || (!additional && !hasOwnSection))
4837 {
4838 count+=mg->countGroupedInheritedMembers(lt);
4839 }
4840 }
4841 //printf("%s:countMembersIncludingGrouped(lt=%s,%s)=%d\n",
4842 // qPrint(name()),qPrint(lt.to_string()),ml?qPrint(ml->listType().to_string()):"<none>",count);
4843 return count;
4844}
4845
4846
4847void ClassDefImpl::writeInheritedMemberDeclarations(OutputList &ol,ClassDefSet &visitedClasses,
4848 MemberListType lt,MemberListType lt2,const DString &title,
4849 const ClassDef *inheritedFrom,bool invert,bool showAlways) const
4850{
4851 int count = countMembersIncludingGrouped(lt,inheritedFrom,false);
4852 bool process = count>0;
4853 //printf("%s: writeInheritedMemberDec: lt=%s process=%d invert=%d always=%d\n",
4854 // qPrint(name()),qPrint(lt.to_string()),process,invert,showAlways);
4855 if ((process^invert) || showAlways)
4856 {
4857 for (const auto &ibcd : m_inherits)
4858 {
4859 ClassDefMutable *icd=toClassDefMutable(ibcd.classDef);
4860 if (icd && icd->isLinkable())
4861 {
4862 MemberListType lt1 = MemberListType::Invalid();
4863 MemberListType lt3 = MemberListType::Invalid();
4864 convertProtectionLevel(lt,ibcd.prot,&lt1,&lt3);
4865 if (lt2.isInvalid() && !lt3.isInvalid())
4866 {
4867 lt2=lt3;
4868 }
4869 //printf("%s:convert %s->(%s,%s) prot=%d\n",qPrint(icd->name()),qPrint(lt.to_string()),
4870 // qPrint(lt1.to_string()),qPrint(lt2.to_string()),ibcd.prot);
4871 if (visitedClasses.find(icd)==visitedClasses.end())
4872 {
4873 visitedClasses.insert(icd); // guard for multiple virtual inheritance
4874 if (!lt1.isInvalid())
4875 {
4876 //printf("--> writeMemberDeclarations for type %s\n",qPrint(lt1.to_string()));
4877 icd->writeMemberDeclarations(ol,visitedClasses,lt1,
4878 title,DString(),false,inheritedFrom,lt2,false,true);
4879 }
4880 }
4881 else
4882 {
4883 //printf("%s: class already visited!\n",qPrint(icd->name()));
4884 }
4885 }
4886 }
4887 }
4888}
4889
4890void ClassDefImpl::writeMemberDeclarations(OutputList &ol,ClassDefSet &visitedClasses,
4891 MemberListType lt,const DString &title,
4892 const DString &subTitle,bool showInline,const ClassDef *inheritedFrom,MemberListType lt2,
4893 bool invert,bool showAlways) const
4894{
4895 //printf("%s: ClassDefImpl::writeMemberDeclarations lt=%s lt2=%s\n",qPrint(name()),qPrint(lt.to_string()),qPrint(lt2.to_string()));
4896 MemberList * ml = getMemberList(lt);
4897 MemberList * ml2 = getMemberList(lt2);
4898 if (getLanguage()==SrcLangExt::VHDL) // use specific declarations function
4899 {
4900 static const ClassDef *cdef;
4901 if (cdef!=this)
4902 { // only one inline link
4903 VhdlDocGen::writeInlineClassLink(this,ol);
4904 cdef=this;
4905 }
4906 if (ml)
4907 {
4908 VhdlDocGen::writeVhdlDeclarations(ml,ol,nullptr,this,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);
4909 }
4910 }
4911 else
4912 {
4913 //printf("%s::writeMemberDeclarations(%s) ml=%p ml2=%p\n",qPrint(name()),qPrint(title),(void*)ml,(void*)ml2);
4914 DString tt = title, st = subTitle;
4915 if (ml)
4916 {
4917 //printf(" writeDeclarations ml type=%s count=%d\n",qPrint(lt.to_string()),ml->numDecMembers(inheritedFrom));
4918 ml->writeDeclarations(ol,this,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr,tt,st,false,showInline,inheritedFrom,lt,true);
4919 tt.clear();
4920 st.clear();
4921 }
4922 if (ml2)
4923 {
4924 //printf(" writeDeclarations ml2 type=%s count=%d\n",qPrint(lt2.to_string()),ml2->numDecMembers(inheritedFrom));
4925 ml2->writeDeclarations(ol,this,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr,tt,st,false,showInline,inheritedFrom,lt,ml==nullptr);
4926 }
4927 bool inlineInheritedMembers = Config_getBool(INLINE_INHERITED_MEMB);
4928 if (!inlineInheritedMembers) // show inherited members as separate lists
4929 {
4930 writeInheritedMemberDeclarations(ol,visitedClasses,lt,lt2,title,
4931 inheritedFrom ? inheritedFrom : this,
4932 invert,showAlways);
4933 }
4934 }
4935}

5254bool ClassDefImpl::isEmbeddedInOuterScope() const
5255{
5256 bool inlineGroupedClasses = Config_getBool(INLINE_GROUPED_CLASSES);
5257 bool inlineSimpleClasses = Config_getBool(INLINE_SIMPLE_STRUCTS);
5258
5259 Definition *container = getOuterScope();
5260
5261 bool containerLinkable =
5262 container &&
5263 (
5264 (container==Doxygen::globalScope && getFileDef() && getFileDef()->isLinkableInProject()) || // global class in documented file
5265 container->isLinkableInProject() // class in documented scope
5266 );
5267
5268 if (isAnonymous())
5269 {
5270 return false; // don't inline an anonymous class
5271 }
5272
5273 // inline because of INLINE_GROUPED_CLASSES=YES ?
5274 bool b1 = (inlineGroupedClasses && !partOfGroups().empty()); // a grouped class
5275 // inline because of INLINE_SIMPLE_STRUCTS=YES ?
5276 bool b2 = (inlineSimpleClasses && m_isSimple && // a simple class
5277 (containerLinkable || // in a documented container
5278 !partOfGroups().empty() // or part of a group
5279 )
5280 );
5281 //printf("%s::isEmbeddedInOuterScope(): inlineGroupedClasses=%d "
5282 // "inlineSimpleClasses=%d partOfGroups()=%d m_isSimple=%d "
5283 // "getOuterScope()=%s b1=%d b2=%d\n",
5284 // qPrint(name()),inlineGroupedClasses,inlineSimpleClasses,
5285 // !partOfGroups().empty(),m_isSimple,getOuterScope()?qPrint(getOuterScope()->name()):"<none>",b1,b2);
5286 return b1 || b2; // either reason will do
5287}

5334bool ClassDefImpl::containsOverload(const MemberDef *md) const
5335{
5336 AUTO_TRACE("name={}",md->name());
5337 const auto &mni = m_allMemberNameInfoLinkedMap.find(md->name());
5338 if (mni)
5339 {
5340 for (const auto &mi : *mni)
5341 {
5342 const MemberDef *classMd = mi->memberDef();
5343 const ArgumentList &classAl = classMd->argumentList();
5344 const ArgumentList &al = md->argumentList();
5345 bool found = matchArguments2(
5346 classMd->getOuterScope(),classMd->getFileDef(),classMd->typeString(),&classAl,
5347 md->getOuterScope(),md->getFileDef(),md->typeString(),&al,
5348 true,getLanguage()
5349 );
5350 if (found)
5351 {
5352 AUTO_TRACE_EXIT("true");
5353 return true;
5354 }
5355 }
5356 }
5357 AUTO_TRACE_EXIT("false");
5358 return false;
5359}

5510bool classHasVisibleRoot(const BaseClassList &bcl)
5511{
5512 for (const auto &bcd : bcl)
5513 {
5514 const ClassDef *cd=bcd.classDef;
5515 if (cd->isVisibleInHierarchy()) return true;
5516 if (classHasVisibleRoot(cd->baseClasses())) return true;
5517 }
5518 return false;
5519}
5520
5521bool classHasVisibleChildren(const ClassDef *cd)
5522{
5523 BaseClassList bcl;
5524
5525 if (cd->getLanguage()==SrcLangExt::VHDL) // reverse baseClass/subClass relation
5526 {
5527 if (cd->baseClasses().empty()) return false;
5528 bcl=cd->baseClasses();
5529 }
5530 else
5531 {
5532 if (cd->subClasses().empty()) return false;
5533 bcl=cd->subClasses();
5534 }
5535
5536 for (const auto &bcd : bcl)
5537 {
5538 if (bcd.classDef->isVisibleInHierarchy())
5539 {
5540 return true;
5541 }
5542 }
5543 return false;
5544}

5546bool classVisibleInIndex(const ClassDef *cd)
5547{
5548 bool allExternals = Config_getBool(ALLEXTERNALS);
5549 return (allExternals && cd->isLinkable()) || cd->isLinkableInProject();
5550}
5551
5552//----------------------------------------------------------------------
5553// recursive function that returns the number of branches in the
5554// inheritance tree that the base class 'bcd' is below the class 'cd'
5555
5556int minClassDistance(const ClassDef *cd,const ClassDef *bcd,int level)
5557{
5558 const int maxInheritanceDepth = 100000;
5559 if (bcd->categoryOf()) // use class that is being extended in case of
5560 // an Objective-C category
5561 {
5562 bcd=bcd->categoryOf();
5563 }
5564 if (cd==bcd) return level;
5565 if (level==256)
5566 {
5567 warn_uncond("class {} seem to have a recursive inheritance relation!\n",cd->name());
5568 return -1;
5569 }
5570 int m=maxInheritanceDepth;
5571 for (const auto &bcdi : cd->baseClasses())
5572 {
5573 int mc=minClassDistance(bcdi.classDef,bcd,level+1);
5574 if (mc<m) m=mc;
5575 if (m<0) break;
5576 }
5577 return m;
5578}
5579
5580Protection classInheritedProtectionLevel(const ClassDef *cd,const ClassDef *bcd,Protection prot,int level)
5581{
5582 if (bcd->categoryOf()) // use class that is being extended in case of
5583 // an Objective-C category
5584 {
5585 bcd=bcd->categoryOf();
5586 }
5587 if (cd==bcd)
5588 {
5589 goto exit;
5590 }
5591 if (level==256)
5592 {
5593 err("Internal inconsistency: found class {} seem to have a recursive "
